main_text.p: diaboli ecclesia fit. Papæ enim, dicit, ad sua defi-deria coacervare sibi magistros auribus prurien-tes: per Cardinales & episcopos Christi nomen in-tergentes blasphemari, clavium potestate emungi pecunias, improbos ordinari, Simoniacas nundina-tiones exerceri, ambitione & avaritia effuare pra-latos, in monasteriis horrida fieri flagitia, Romam repleri impudicissimis scortis, atque his similia plu-ra.

Multo adhuc plura graviora quoque Romae agitur, præter ea quae Theatinus in eo attigit libello. At-tigit enim vitia tantum & abusus, qui in vita communi occurrere solent, nulla prorsus facta mentione doctrinæ quæ illic colitur, quæ Christi Evangelio tam quā ex diametro pugnat. Neque tyrannides eorum plus quam Neronicas in medium attulit, quibus aper-te saeviunt carceribus, laqueis, igne, ferro, exilio, re-mis & aquis: eos persequentes per Italiam, Galliam, Hispaniam, & Angliam, qui spiritu Dei acti, horren-das eorum contaminationes ac religionis Christia-nae profanationes ferre non possint. His addo, quae Guilhelmus Vuittyngamus docte & vere de Anglia scribit in præfatione super D. Ridlei af-fertione contra transsubstantiationis haeresim. page.notes: The right edge of the scan is cut, so the ends of lines 1–4 and of the last lines are only partly visible. Doubtful readings: "effuare" (may be a printing error), "doctrinæ" (the abbreviated form is unclear), "bonarumq" (the abbreviation mark is unclear), and the catchword "fica" below the right margin, which may be the start of the next page's word. The line "Papæ" may carry a ligature. Ornaments and ink spots at the foot are not text.
